name: Hino Yachika
source:
Mia's closer friend.

Hairpin: she can open certain chests or door's locks with her hairpin.

Fears: bugs, humanoids, guts.

[spoiler]Mia is more than her best friend. She will enter in 'desperation mode' if she watches Mia's corpse.[/spoiler]

Family: father (carpenter); mother; older brother.
